已发送但未收到主机确认，将以同一编号自动重试（不会重复执行）: Sent but not confirmed by the host; it will retry with the same ID (never executed twice)
主机未连接，待确认的操作将在恢复后以同一编号重发: Host disconnected; pending operations will be resent with the same ID
副 POS 不直接写入业务数据，请经主 POS 执行: The secondary does not write business data directly; use the main POS
设备已被主机撤销: This device was revoked by the host
设备未与本主机配对: This device is not paired with the host
设备密钥与配对记录不符: Device key does not match the pairing record
主机身份与配对记录不符: Host identity does not match the pairing record
主机当前没有有效的配对码: The host has no valid pairing code
主机当前门店与请求不一致: Host store does not match the request
网口 ESC/POS 打印机由主 POS 统一发送；未配置的档口为模拟打印（受显: Network ESC/POS printers are driven by the main POS; stations without a printer use simulated printing (affected by the paper-out switch in Display)
由主 POS 统一发送；未配置打印机的档口使用模拟打印。「已发送」表示已写入打印: Sent by the main POS; stations without a printer use simulation. "Sent" means written to the printer with a normal status, not confirmed paper output.
请填写打印机 IP 或主机名: Enter the printer IP or host name
纸宽应为 58mm（32 列）或 80mm（48 列）: Paper must be 58mm (32 cols) or 80mm (48 cols)
该打印机有发送中或结果未知的任务，请先核对: This printer has sending or unknown jobs; check them first
例如：厨房已收到完整单据: e.g. kitchen received the full ticket
发送中断或打印机报错，可能已部分或全部出纸。请到打印机旁核对后选择，系统不会自动: Sending was interrupted or the printer reported an error; the ticket may be partly or fully printed. Check at the printer and choose. It is never reprinted automatically, to avoid duplicate dishes.
已记录未出纸，并生成关联补打: Recorded not printed; linked reprint queued

打印机脱机（可能开盖或缺纸）: Printer offline (cover open or out of paper)
应用重启时正在发送，结果未知: Was sending when the app restarted; result unknown
发送后打印机报错（开盖/缺纸/故障），可能未完整出纸: Printer reported an error after sending (cover/paper/fault); output may be incomplete
模拟厨房打印机仍缺纸，换纸后会自动重试: Simulated kitchen printer still out of paper; retries after refill
